---
title: "Ex2 - Filtering and Sorting Data (Euro 2012) - Solutions"
output: html_document
---

This time we are going to pull data directly from the internet.

### Step 1. Import the necessary libraries

```{r step1, message=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
```

### Step 2. Import the dataset from this [address](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guipsamora/pandas_exercises/master/02_Filtering_%26_Sorting/Euro12/Euro_2012_stats_TEAM.csv).

### Step 3. Assign it to a variable called euro12.

```{r}
# the same file is also included in this folder: read_csv("Euro_2012_stats_TEAM.csv")
euro12 <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/guipsamora/pandas_exercises/master/02_Filtering_%26_Sorting/Euro12/Euro_2012_stats_TEAM.csv")
euro12
```

### Step 4. Select only the Goal column.

```{r}
euro12$Goals

# or, keeping it as a tibble
euro12 |> select(Goals)
```

### Step 5. How many team participated in the Euro2012?

```{r}
nrow(euro12)
```

### Step 6. What is the number of columns in the dataset?

```{r}
ncol(euro12)

glimpse(euro12)
```

### Step 7. View only the columns Team, Yellow Cards and Red Cards and assign them to a dataframe called discipline

```{r}
# column names with spaces must be written between backticks
discipline <- euro12 |> select(Team, `Yellow Cards`, `Red Cards`)
discipline
```

### Step 8. Sort the teams by Red Cards, then to Yellow Cards

```{r}
discipline |> arrange(desc(`Red Cards`), desc(`Yellow Cards`))
```

### Step 9. Calculate the mean Yellow Cards given per Team

```{r}
round(mean(discipline$`Yellow Cards`))
```

### Step 10. Filter teams that scored more than 6 goals

```{r}
euro12 |> filter(Goals > 6)
```

### Step 11. Select the teams that start with G

```{r}
euro12 |> filter(str_starts(Team, "G"))
```

### Step 12. Select the first 7 columns

```{r}
# select() also accepts column positions
euro12 |> select(1:7)
```

### Step 13. Select all columns except the last 3.

```{r}
euro12 |> select(1:(ncol(euro12) - 3))

# or with base R
# euro12[, 1:(ncol(euro12) - 3)]
```

### Step 14. Present only the Shooting Accuracy from England, Italy and Russia

```{r}
euro12 |>
  filter(Team %in% c("England", "Italy", "Russia")) |>
  select(Team, `Shooting Accuracy`)
```
